dedupe_keys.name: fntp public works economic statistics monthly and quarterly business bulletins france

description: The French national federation of public works contractors (FNTP) publishes economic statistics on the public works sector, which builds and maintains roads, networks and other infrastructure. Its economy and statistics page gives headline figures on firms and about 331,000 employees in public works, a monthly business bulletin (number 328 for July 2026) with year-on-year change in work done and contracts signed in volume, hours worked, temporary work hours, manual workforce and production costs (the TP01 index), and a quarterly barometer of business climate with opinion balances. The page also lists studies and memos on infrastructure investment, the cost of under-investment, local authority funding schemes and markets such as data centres and heat networks. The bulletins are free to read as PDF documents and no licence is stated on the page. Caveats: figures are sector-wide indicators from a trade federation, not asset data, and they are in French. Coverage is France. It supports economic analysis of infrastructure investment and construction capacity, such as the cost and workforce available for repair and recovery after disasters; there are no related records in the catalogue yet.
